data.selection: existing qacpa.victim.select_label_indices seed0 batches0-4; all80 unique originals; no LPIPS selection

uia.feature_computation: cached frozen convolutional features, no repeated image forwards during local SGD
uia.shuffle: fixed full-batch order; for n16 and nominal minibatch32 author shuffle changes reduction order only

stage1.seed_rule: seed_all(victim_seed+batch_index); CPA initializes identity with no random restarts
stage1.failure_policy: stop on failed whitening or fewer than16 sources; no reduced-rank or oracle-target fallback
stage1.source_adapter: abs(S_hat); permutation-only Hungarian on absolute source cosine for correspondence; no true source substitution

rank.predicted_B_eff: count top16 centered observed covariance eigenvalues > c_mp*mp_edge; sigma2=mp_edge=0 at fp32; nominal no-noise ceiling16
rank.numerical_rank: report centered top16 singular-value rank separately using max(abs_tol, rel_tol*s_max); not a quantization threshold or reason to drop sources
rank.measured_B_eff: count matched absolute source cosine >0.9 among all16 original sources

evaluation.lpips: torchmetrics VGG, existing qacpa.fia RGB[-1,1] convention

gia_reference.caveat: historical36CPA+4exact-source FIA hybrid, different victim batch composition and n; same FIA hyperparameters only

reference_range_met.action: record fp32 reference-range agreement; 4bit remains prohibited in this queue

protocol_difference_review.action: identify protocol difference and footnote; keep FedAvg

pipeline_review.action: inspect pipeline; do not proceed to4bit

decision.other_values: unclassified by requested bands; report and review without choosing a new cutoff
